reponse:
Nothing is confirmed yet. The planning assumption is **$0.08 per ACH item** for 2027, but Corvane may raise it.

- The Q1 2027 pricing memo assumes the Corvane per-item ACH fee stays at $0.08 in 2027. It says to revisit the pricing if the fee goes above $0.10. The current Corvane agreement runs until March 31, 2027, and renewal talks were to open in November [1].
- The October invoice fits that rate: $14,212.40 for 177,655 ACH items [5].
- Marcus Oyelaran says Corvane's relationship manager hinted they want to raise the per-item fee after the November 10 rejected file, but "nothing on paper yet." The renewal call moved to the week of November 23 [6].

So the $0.08 is the working assumption, and the real 2027 rate depends on the renewal negotiation.
